text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Shuka Sho, I take
Yukino Bijin
to visit her hometown of
Morioka.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me t'go back home in
this
state?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'll start bawl'n my eyes out
when I see
everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But if I cry m'heart out and then feel all
better
after, I might not wanna go back
to the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah?
choice_data_list: そうなったら、たくさん説得するよ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 君の走る姿が好きだからな
貴方の走る姿が好きだからね

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, really.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, we arrive at the village
where she was
born and raised.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's noth'n better than the fresh
air here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Mifuyu?
choice_data_list: じゃあ、美冬さんのところへ行こうか

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does that mean we're head'n to
the skating
rink?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Jinkies! It's been ages since I last got
t'see Mifuyu
skate!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, really? She must be gett'n ready
for her
badge test...
choice_data_list: 今日はジャンプの練習がメインだって

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't pass her next one, she
won't be able
t'enter big competitions.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The problem is she's always had trouble
with her
jumps.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're right! But y'know, Mifuyu's real
strength
lies in her expressiveness.
choice_data_list: それで努力してるのか
それで努力してるんだね

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why she'll be invincible if she can
nail her
jumps, but she's still the berries
either way! Hehe,
I can't wait t'see
her! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin and I head to the skating
rink to see
Mifuyu. When we arrive...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers! It's like she's fly'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu glides effortlessly across the ice,
dancing
with a graceful weightlessness.
The sharp edges of
her skates throw a
flurry of glittering crystals into
the air.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Amaz'n... When'd she get so good? She's
so...
glam'rous.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for wait'n up! Welcome back,
Yuki!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's great t'see you, Mifuyu! But enough
of the
pleasantries!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You were incredible out there! Your jumps were stunn'n!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Aw shucks! They weren't that good!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I wanted to show off for
you after I
learned how t'jump
properly. ♪ That's why I asked
your
trainer t'bring you here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't b'lieve you're the same Mifuyu I
used t'go
t'school with! The same one
who used t'cry every
time you messed up
a jump!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You must've been work'n real hard ever
since I
left for Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Well, I kinda didn't have a
choice.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I guess it was right about when you ran
in the
Japanese Oaks that my coach told
me t'give up
on my dream.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Coach said I didn't have what it takes
t'go to the
world championship, but that
I'm real expressive
on the ice and should
try doing shows instead.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I already knew all that, though. People
even
younger than me were already
pass'n all the tests
and well on their way
to the world championship.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No way could I compete with them. I
started
think'n I might not become the
person I wanna
be—that I might not have
what it takes t'reach my
dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Mifuyu...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But you know what happened? I saw you
run!
After that, I knew I couldn't give up
on my
dreams! No way, José!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? My runn'n... did that?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yup. I've always looked up t'you, Yuki.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's had high hopes for your
future ever
since we were kids. And look
at you now, runn'n in
all these big-name
races!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I could see how close you'd gotten to
your dream,
but you were still gritt'n
your teeth and try'n as
hard as you could
to go even further.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
How could I give up, seeing you like
that? I
wanna be the kind of friend you
can be proud of,
even while you're shin'n
like the sun!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon. What're you gett'n all teary
for?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's just... I don't deserve all that
praise...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I wanna run
away—sometimes I just
wanna give up,
right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But you'd never actually run away, right?
Even
when Coach was putt'n you
through the wringer,
you never gave up.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
We've known each other forever, so I
know you
can be a little timid
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
But you're also sweet, honest, and
stronger than
anyone I know! That's the
Yuki I know—my super
spiffy, extra
special best friend!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So thank you, Yuki. It's because of you
that I was
able to stay strong.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You stopped me from los'n sight of the
person I
wanna become, and I can't
thank you enough for
that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! M-Mifuyuuu! Sob...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, the dam holding her
emotions back
suddenly bursts, and
tears begin flooding down
Yukino Bijin's
cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I'm okay now. I know I can't give
up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta keep chas'n my dream, just
like Mifuyu.
I've gotta become a
glam'rous city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't be think'n of quitt'n when my best
friend is
out there giv'n it her all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I have t'become the best Umamusume I
can be—a
strong, stylish city girl who
won't lose out
t'anyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But that's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It made me real happy hear'n how
Mifuyu felt
inspired after watch'n me
run.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's another thing I wanna
do—be a
shin'n inspiration for others.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So it sounds like I got two goals now.
First, I
wanna run in a way that makes me
love myself...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And I wanna become a city girl that
ev'ryone truly
loves with all their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Putt'n it into words like that
makes it sound
like a pretty tall order,
though!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We still gotta decide our next race goal,
right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's someth'n I wanna
do. I'm
done lett'n others push their
narratives on me. If
all eyes are on me, I
wanna be the one operat'n
the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I figure a lotta the support I've
gotten up
till now's been sheer luck.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just happened t'show up at a time when everyone just happened t'be interested in racers from the countryside.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But so far, I haven't been able to turn
the pass'n
fancy into anyth'n more
substantial.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But y'know what? Not even Oguri
started out as a
legend.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she must've worked real hard in
order
t'go from being a mere nine days'
wonder to a
true mainstay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm gett'n too big for my
britches, but I
wanna approach this next
adventure like I'm
start'n from
scratch—go from zero to hero!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna buckle down and focus hard on
my train'n
so I can show everyone a new
me come senior
year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is a medium-distance G1
race held
at the start of the year. It's
usually full of tough
opponents, and
should be the ideal race for a
fresh start.
choice_data_list: なら、『大阪杯』を目標にしようか

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sounds good!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: D'you think I can do it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
D'you think I can make as big a splash as
Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Am I really capable of someth'n that
grand?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's accomplishments in the
Triple Tiara
tour weren't luck. She
earned them with her own
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And at this point, I know her. She won't
give up
until she's made sure everyone's
seen the real her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll show ev'ryone just how
determined this
Morioka racer can be!
choice_data_list: 貴方の本気を届けよう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we set the Osaka Hai as
our first
senior-year race goal.
